mechanism: Both agents can inhibit CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2D6) and may increase gastrointestinal upset; berberine may also enhance minocycline's photosensitivity risk and both have potential hepatotoxic effects with chronic use.
action: Monitor for increased adverse effects including photosensitivity, GI disturbances, and hepatic function; counsel patient on sun protection and consider alternative agents if hepatic impairment is present.
